_readme: Explicit retirement manifest for Supabase Edge Functions.
Deleting a function's directory from this repository does NOT remove it from
Supabase. The deploy script only ever deploys; nothing retires. That is how
ten career-ai-* functions stayed live with no source, filling the project's
100-function cap and blocking their own replacement from deploying.
This file is the ONLY thing that authorizes a production deletion.
Absence from the repository is never sufficient — see scripts/retire-supabase-functions.sh.
To retire a function: add an entry below, in a pull request, reviewed like any
other change. Then run the 'Retire Supabase Edge Functions' workflow in plan
mode, read the plan, and only then run it in apply mode with the confirmation
phrase. Entries are kept after retirement as a permanent record; re-running is
a no-op once the function is gone.
